title: Crestline Fleet Account Mobile Visit Fee by Vehicles Served
content:
On a contested mobile service visit fee of a Crestline Fleet Account, the fee the visit owes starts from an amount set by the number of vehicles served.

## Vehicles served

The vehicles served on a visit are counted as the invoices dated the visit day from the store that sent the crew, other than mobile service visit fee invoices, so a vehicle invoiced for two kinds of work counts twice. The visit day is the date of the visit fee invoice and the store is that invoice's servicing store.

## Starting amount of the fee owed

| Vehicles served, compared with the program's minimum vehicles for a mobile visit | The fee owed starts from |
|---|---|
| at least twice the minimum | nothing (0.00) |
| more than the minimum but fewer than twice the minimum | the program's mobile service fee less 12.00 for each vehicle beyond the minimum, never below 0.00 |
| otherwise (the minimum or fewer) | the program's mobile service fee |

## The thresholds per program

| Program | Minimum vehicles for a mobile visit | Twice the minimum | Program's mobile service fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Fleet Starter | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Business | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Commercial | 3 | 6 | 49.00 |
| Crestline Fleet National | 2 | 4 | 0.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Enterprise | 1 | 2 | 0.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Public Sector | 3 | 6 | 49.00 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical program with a minimum of 3 and a fee of 60.00)

| Vehicles served | The fee owed starts from |
|---|---|
| 2 | 60.00 |
| 3 | 60.00 |
| 4 | 60.00 less 12.00, that is 48.00 |
| 5 | 60.00 less 24.00, that is 36.00 |
| 6 | nothing: 0.00 |

The fee owed is never below 0.00, the floor being applied once after every addition and credit, not to each amount in turn.
